semantic_fragments.content: Risk Management Results Table (Clause 4.2.2): General requirements for RISK MANAGEMENT per ISO 14971. All reviewed clauses (4.2 through 7.1) reference Risk Management Report DN: PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0 and all verdicts are PASS (P). Coverage includes: adequate resources, qualified personnel assignment, risk acceptability policy, RM analyst qualifications, scope definition, responsibilities and authorities, requirement achievement, risk acceptability criteria, verification activities, hazard traceability, risk analysis procedure, intended use and safety characteristics analysis, hazard identification, risk estimation, risk evaluation, and risk control procedure.

Dielectric strength insulation test requirements under IEC60601-1 Annex L: Five samples subjected to dielectric strength and bending tests per L.3.2. Test voltages must meet Tables 6 and 7 minimums: 1500V for Basic/Supplementary Insulation, 3000V for Reinforced Insulation, applied between shot and conductor. Production routine (100%) testing: 1500V r.m.s./2100V peak for Basic/Supplementary; 3000V r.m.s./4200V peak for Reinforced. Sampling tests per IEC 60851-5:1996 clause 4.4.1: minimum breakdown voltage at least twice Tables 6&7 values: 3000V r.m.s./4200V peak for Basic/Supplementary; 6000V r.m.s./8400V peak for Reinforced. All items marked N/A.
